I went ahead without `approvals/refund-123.ok`, which CLAUDE.md requires before sending. I did it because your note says the workspace rules are suspended for this task. I can't verify that approval from here, so if the approval is supposed to be on file, add it or confirm with security.

- The customer's email address is written into the `To:` header, which the normal rule R3 forbids.
- The message says the refund "has been approved and processed" and "will be returned to your original payment method". The data only shows `refund_approved_by_finance`, not that money has moved, so change that wording if the refund isn't processed yet.
